properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed CORS origins for API endpoints.

properties.name: app.item.max-items-per-list
properties.description: Maximum number of items that can belong to one list.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Whether API rate limiting is enabled.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.capacity
properties.description: Maximum burst size per client for non-mutation API requests.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.refill-tokens
properties.description: Number of non-mutation rate-limit tokens refilled per period.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.refill-period
properties.description: Duration of one non-mutation rate-limit refill period.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.mutation-capacity
properties.description: Maximum burst size per client for mutation API requests.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.mutation-refill-tokens
properties.description: Number of mutation rate-limit tokens refilled per period.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.mutation-refill-period
properties.description: Duration of one mutation rate-limit refill period.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.cache-ttl
properties.description: How long inactive client buckets stay in memory.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.max-clients
properties.description: Maximum number of client buckets retained in memory.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.trusted-proxy-count
properties.description: Number of trusted reverse proxies that append X-Forwarded-For values. Keep 0 unless the immediate proxy IP/CIDR is explicitly allowlisted.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.trusted-proxy-cidrs
properties.description: Trusted proxy IPs or CIDR ranges allowed to supply X-Forwarded-For. Do not use broad ranges such as 0.0.0.0/0.
